# Scott's Suits

> Scott's Suits (scottssuits.com) sells affordable custom men's suits, made to measure and designed entirely online. Full suits cost $350 to $400, jackets $265 to $300 and pants $150 to $180, depending on the fabric. No showroom visit or fitting is needed, and the suit is delivered to your door.

Key facts:

- Made-to-measure men's suits, jackets and pants, each cut to the customer's own measurements.
- Price is set by the fabric: suits from $350, jackets from $265, pants from $150. Every style option is included at no extra cost except full canvas construction (+$200) and a custom photo lining (+$80).
- Nearly 200 fabrics, including 120 pure wool fabrics in black, navy and grays (solids, pinstripes, herringbones, plaids).
- Customers choose the lapel (notch, peak, shawl and more), single or double-breasted buttons, pockets, vents, lining, button color, monogram, and pants details such as pleats and cuffs.
- Free picture of the finished suit before ordering (with a free account).
- Measurements: copy a suit that already fits, measure your body and pick a fit, or estimate from your usual size. Partner tailors in New Jersey, New York and Indiana can measure in person.
- Alteration Protection: $100 per item for three free alterations.
- Ships to your door at the cheapest carrier rate, or free in-store pickup. Order tracking and one-tap reorders in My Account.
- Payment by card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or Klarna.
- Contact: hello@scottssuits.com. Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/scott_suits/
